title: Sunflower Keys — Hear three little calls change their order
help: Each call visits the same three note colors. The three orders use the same nine seeds: calls together, colors together, or a reversed middle call. Choose Drawn to hear the difference. Planting stays silent.
message: phrases experiments keep their distinct rules and exact supplied choices
facts: Each uses exactly the nine seeds0/1/2/5/6/7/10/11/12; modulo5 gives three each of colors0,1,2. The middle-back sequence changes only positions4–6 of the drawn order. No timing, semitone or longer-note claim.
